integrity: The claim is proved directly from the code definition and an information-set projection lemma. No independence or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the characteristic-face code C_Delta^* on a full vertex set and reduces higher weights to a fixed-cardinality induced-subcomplex optimization; it does not solve the complementary anticode or topological-operation hierarchy problems.
title: Full generalized Hamming hierarchy from induced subcomplex maxima
